about.body:
PIA Bazzite {version}

A small, unofficial Linux client for Private Internet Access on Bazzite. It uses WireGuard and NetworkManager.

Project: github.com/adventureFAN/PIA-Bazzite
App ID: io.github.adventurefan.PIABazzite

PIA Bazzite is not affiliated with or endorsed by Private Internet Access. Third-party notices are included in the project package.

emergency_reset.complete_message: The PIA VPN is disconnected and PIA Bazzite's Kill Switch firewall has been verified as removed. Normal system networking is available again. It is now outside VPN protection, so your real public IP address may be visible. The Kill Switch remains enabled for the next VPN connection.
emergency_reset.confirm_message:
PIA Bazzite first stops the PIA VPN and then verifies that it is fully disconnected. The Kill Switch firewall remains active during this check. Only then may the installed helper remove PIA Bazzite's fixed Kill Switch firewall. Other firewall tables are not changed.

After a successful reset, your normal internet connection is restored without VPN protection. Your real public IP address may then be visible. The Kill Switch setting remains enabled for the next connection.

Continue?

kill_switch.detail.active:
The VPN is connected. The kill switch has been verified
and prevents traffic outside the VPN tunnel.
kill_switch.detail.armed:
The VPN is intentionally disconnected. The kill switch is enabled,
but it does not block normal internet access in this state.
The firewall lock will be enabled before the next VPN connection starts.
kill_switch.detail.blocking:
The VPN is not connected. The verified kill switch blocks
normal internet traffic so that no connection leaves
through your real public IP address.
kill_switch.detail.error:
Kill-switch protection could not be verified.
The VPN connection was not started or was disconnected for safety.
Open the Live Log for details.
kill_switch.detail.ready:
The VPN is disconnected and the kill switch is not active.
Your device is using its normal internet connection with your real public IP address.
kill_switch.detail.vpn_only:
The VPN is connected, but the kill switch is disabled.
After an unexpected drop, the device can return to the normal
internet connection using the real public IP address.
kill_switch.helper_install.install_messa:
VPN protection needs a small root-owned system component. It provides the IPv6-only guard for normal VPN connections and the optional Session Kill Switch.

PIA Bazzite will copy the component included in this AppImage to /usr/local/libexec/pia-bazzite after administrator authorization. No VPN or firewall state is changed by this installation.

During first-time setup, two administrator prompts may therefore appear in succession: one to install the component and one to start the requested protected firewall session.
kill_switch.helper_install.update_messag:
The installed VPN protection system component does not exactly match this PIA Bazzite AppImage. It must be updated before a protected VPN connection can start.

The update requires administrator authorization and does not change VPN or firewall state.

Two administrator prompts may therefore appear in succession: one to update the component and one to start the requested protected firewall session.

menu.kill_switch_tooltip: Blocks normal network traffic before VPN startup and after an unexpected VPN failure for the current system session. Protection is not persistent across reboot.

options.auto_connect_tooltip:
Controls whether and which location PIA Bazzite connects to automatically after the startup checks finish.

With Session Kill Switch enabled, its full firewall provides this protection.
